OFFICE OF THE SUPREME COMMANDER
FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 403 (7 Oct 45) MG
(SCAPIN-101)
APO 500
7 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Cultivation of Nori (Laver)
1. Reference is made to your CLO No. 144 dated 2 October 1945 concerning the cultivation of “nori.”
2. All aspects of the cultivation and collection of “nori” are permitted subject to the following regulations.
a. Fishing areas have been established in which Japanese fishing boats may operate freely. These include all areas of “nori” culture along the coast of Japan.(Memo No 80, 27 Sep 45 FLTLOSCAP)
b. All Japanese boats must keep clear of Naval restricted areas(Memo No.55, 14 Sep 45, FLTLOSCAP)
c. All Japanese boats must obey all instructions from United States or Allied military authorities. (And Memo No.35, above).
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/H. W. Allen
/t/H. W. ALLEN
Colonel, A. G. D.
Asst. Adjutant General.
